name: Using This Book
pages: The {i}Book of the Mechanist{/} has some helpful features that make it easy to navigate!{pb}When you open the book, you'll be brought to the {b}home page{/}, where you'll find two buttons in the bottom-left corner. The first can change the {b}size{/} of the UI, and the second will open a list of {b}recently-viewed entries{/}.

On the right side, the guidebook {b}categories{/} will be displayed. Click on a category to open it, and then click on the {b}chapter{/} you would like to read. One of the categories is the {b}Entry Index{/}. From the index, begin typing anything to {b}search{/} for a specific chapter or category by title.

If there are more pages to veiw in the chapter, there will be will be arrows to {b}turn the page{/} forward or backward at the bottom of the book. (You can also {c}scroll{/c} through pages.) {c}Right-click{/c} or click the back arrow at the bottom of the book to return to the {b}previous entry{/}. You can {c}shift-click{/c} the back arrow to return to the home page.

Along the right edge of the book are your {b}bookmark tabs{/}, which you can click to go directly to that entry. Click the {b}[+]{/} tab to add a bookmark for the current page, or {c}shift-click{/c} a bookmark to remove it.{pb}$(#9E33F5)$(n)Purple text{/} is a clickable link to another chapter. $(#CF1546)$(l)Red text{/} will show more information when you hover your mouse over it. {c}Gold text{/c} are controls. {i}Green text{/} are items.
